stem.text: The volume of water in a tank, measured in liters, is modeled by a twice-differentiable function V of time t, measured in hours. It is known that \( V''(6) = -4.5 \). Using correct units, interpret the meaning of \( V''(6) = -4.5 \) in the context of the problem.

answer_key.label: At time t = 6 hours, the rate at which the volume of water in the tank is changing is decreasing at a rate of 4.5 liters per hour per hour.

worked_solution.text: \( V''(6) \) is the rate of change of \( V' \), the rate at which the volume of water in the tank changes, so it is measured in liters per hour per hour.
worked_solution.rule_named: second derivative as the rate of change of a rate

worked_solution.text: The value is negative, so at t = 6 the rate of change of the volume of water in the tank is itself decreasing, by 4.5 liters per hour for each hour.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the second derivative gives the direction of change of the rate

options.label: At time t = 6 hours, the rate at which the volume of water in the tank is changing is increasing at a rate of 4.5 liters per hour per hour.
options.derivation: the negative value reported as a magnitude and described as an increase
